h:
基于官方 WF 和 RuneXX 令人惊叹的作品的 LTX-2.3 的简单（至少在视觉上）工作流程。
放下您的图像，选择一两个通道并激活 Sage Attention（可选），然后输入您的提示、长度和尺寸，然后开始！

您将需要一些额外的节点（这些节点非常有用，您应该已经安装它们）

o.en:
A simple (at least visually) Workflow for LTX-2.3 based on the official WF and RuneXX amazing work.
Drop your image(s), select one or two passes and activate Sage Attention (optional) and type your prompt, length and dimensions AND GO!

you'll need a few extra nodes (those are so useful, you should have them installed already)
